Class AccountSettlementService

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.account.settlement.AccountSettlementService
@Service public class AccountSettlementService extends Object
Service to handle pre-trade validation checks and atomic trade settlements for orders.

    • settleOrder

      @Transactional(rollbackFor=Exception.class) public SettlementResponse settleOrder(UUID accountId, SettlementRequest request)
      Settles an executed order atomically by posting to the cash ledger and updating holdings.

      Settles each execution once. order-app retries a settlement whose outcome it never got to record, so a repeat is answered from what was already booked instead of booking the trade a second time.

      Parameters:
      accountId - the unique identifier of the account
      request - the settlement request containing order details
      Returns:
      the settlement response encapsulated in a SettlementResponse DTO
